PART 08
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Understand the basics of cloud collaboration.
✓ Explore tools and platforms that support collaboration
in the cloud.
✓ Assess the benefits and challenges of cloud
collaboration.
✓ Learn methods and strategies to optimize cloud
collaboration.
❖ Objectives
Part 8: Cloud collaboration
✓ Cloud-based collaboration is the use of cloud-based
tools and platforms to work together, share
information, and collaborate in real time.
❖ Cloud-based collaboration
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Working performance: Enhance work team performance
and productivity.
✓ Cost savings: Reduce investment costs in infrastructure and
software.
✓ Access anytime, anywhere: Allows access to documents and
information from anywhere and anytime.
✓ Improve communication: Improve communication and
information sharing within the group.
❖ Benefits of Cloud-Based Collaboration
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Google Workspace: Includes Google Docs, Google
Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Meet.
✓ Microsoft 365: Includes Microsoft Teams, SharePoint,
OneDrive, and Office Online.
✓ Slack: Team messaging and project management tool.
✓ Trello: Project and task management tool based on
Kanban board.
❖ Popular Cloud Collaboration Tools
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Share documents: Allows multiple people to view and
edit documents in real time.
✓ General working schedule: Organize and manage the
group's common work schedule.
✓ Messaging and online meetings: Supports instant
messaging and online meetings.
✓ Project management: Manage tasks, track project
progress and assign work.
❖ Popular Cloud Collaboration Tools
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Challenge:
✓ Data security: Ensure safety and security of data shared in the cloud.
✓ Access management: Ensure appropriate access rights for each
member.
✓ Integration with existing systems: Ensure compatibility and integration
with existing tools and systems.
✓ Solution:
✓ Data encryption: Use encryption methods to protect data.
✓ Manage access rights: Use access management tools to ensure security.
✓ Use APIs: Use APIs and integration tools to connect systems.
❖ Challenges and Solutions of Cloud-Based Collaboration
Part 7: Cloud collaboration
✓ Problem:
✓ Risk of data leakage and sensitive information.
✓ Risk of cyber attacks and malware.
✓ Solution:
✓ Use data encryption.
✓ Set up a strict privacy policy.
✓ Use multi-factor authentication (MFA).
❖ Collaboration tool issues
➢ Security and Privacy
Part 7: Cloud collaboration

✓ Difficulty in decentralizing and controlling access.

✓ Perform periodic checks of access rights

over the Internet instead of the traditional phone network.

Part 7: Cloud collaboration

traditional phones.
